_comment: REALIZEDNULL session 2 (studies/realizednull/SPEC.md §3.8, §9.2 N8, §9.6): the Qwen2.5-14B census core on GB-3's own environment (same image, same forward as infra/vast/cells/v1_ablation.py). Weights are the hub weights baked into shackleton:v1-14b (weights_mode baked, never the bucket). The cell reads every input from results/mdl/realizednull_q14_inputs/ (the four GB-3 prefixes copied server-side, plus N9's corpus196.npy) and asserts each sha256 against infra/vast/cells/realizednull_q14_inputs.json. q14_smoke scores windows 0-7 (C = 0-3, D = 4-7; batches [0-3], [4-7] as GB-3's, SPEC §0.4 U5); q14_full scores windows 0-195 with C = 0-63 and D = 64-97 (§0.4 P7). G14-PRE reproduces GB-3's banked rows before any new number. Pick an RTX A6000 offer with at least 56 GiB host memory (the cell asserts it); expected_gpu holds auto-respawns to RTX A6000 offers (controller.py search_offers) and the box asserts it at boot (lifecycle.sh).
